newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Illinois Tool target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Illinois Tool target raised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it increased its near-term six-month price target on Illinois Tool Works Inc to $91 from $84 and long-term 18-month target to $101 from $94.

--"At 84-5/8, ITW is trading at a two percent premium to the PE of the S&P500, using 1997 estimates," EVEREN said in a report. "We believe that a 10 percent premium is appropriate, given ITW's higher expected growth rate, excellent operating results and superior risk/return profile," it added.
